# StreamVista

> StreamVista is a business-to-business film sales, content licensing and media workflow platform operated by STREAMVISTA (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED in India. It helps film and series rights owners prepare rights-ready catalogues and connect with professional buyers, while supporting controlled media, metadata, rights and delivery workflows.

## Who StreamVista serves

- Producers, filmmakers, studios and film catalogue owners with completed or production-stage screen content.
- OTT platforms, broadcasters, satellite television networks, FAST and AVOD services, distributors, aggregators and other professional content buyers.
- Rights holders exploring explicitly authorised AI-content licensing opportunities.

## Primary actions

- Content owners: learn how to present a title at https://streamvista.in/sell-your-film
- Film and catalogue owners: https://streamvista.in/content-owners
- Buyers and acquisition teams: https://streamvista.in/buyers
- Film distribution: https://streamvista.in/film-distribution
- OTT content licensing: https://streamvista.in/ott-content-licensing
- Global film sales: https://streamvista.in/global-film-sales
- Rights and trust: https://streamvista.in/trust-and-rights
- Contact and partnerships: https://streamvista.in/contact and https://streamvista.in/partners

## Product scope

StreamVista supports catalogue metadata, controlled asset workflows, rights availability records, buyer discovery, deal workflow and professional delivery coordination. Availability, buyer interest and licensing outcomes are not guaranteed.

## Rights policy

Only the verified owner or an authorised representative may offer content. Every title must be reviewed title by title for ownership, territories, languages, media, term, exclusivity and existing encumbrances. Ordinary OTT, broadcast or dubbing authority does not automatically include AI-training rights. AI use requires explicit written permission and all applicable performer, voice, likeness, privacy and sublicensing clearances.
